agyos_skill.intent: Run a six-phase verification of a Claude Code session's work — build, type check, lint, tests with coverage, security grep, and diff review — then produce a PASS/FAIL verification report. Use when verifying work after completing a feature or refactor, before creating a PR, or when quality gates must pass.
agyos_skill.instructions: A comprehensive verification system for Claude Code sessions. Invoke this skill: - After completing a feature or significant code change - Before creating a PR - When you want to ensure quality gates pass - After refactoring > [!NOTE] > **Local Build Policy:** When instructed or in rapid iterative development, do NOT run full production/static export builds locally (e.g., `npm run build:pages` or slow static exports). Only perform fast type checking (`npm run typecheck` / `npx tsc --noEmit`) and unit tests locally. Leave heavy multi-minute builds to remote CI/CD. ```bash set -o pipefail # report the build's exit status, not tail's npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20 pnpm build 2>&1 | tail -20 ``` If build fails, STOP and fix before continuing. ```bash set -o pipefail npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | sed -n '1,30p' pyright . 2>&1 | sed -n '1,30p' ``` Report all type errors. Fix critical ones before continuing. Use `sed` to limit displayed output while consuming the whole stream. This keeps a successful linter from failing on SIGPIPE when `pipefail` is enabled. ```bash set -o pipefail npm run lint 2>&1 | sed -n '1,30p'
